## rebar-debug Phase 1 — legitimacy verdict: hardening/design decision, NOT a localized defect → ESCALATE (no auto-fix)

Investigated on a fresh worktree at origin/main `82a0d5cd` (verified == origin/main). No code
authored. All findings below are static/git facts (verifiable), not a live behavioral claim.

### Step 0 (Orient)
- 0(a) Sweep: this is the only OPEN ticket on the concern; it sits in a dense cluster of CLOSED,
  LANDED tickets on the same completion-verifier runaway-loop seam — `c827`/`splurgy-tangible-halicore`
  (loop breaker), `3211`/`creatable-foldable-arthropods` + a0fc8d43 (memo-served repeats not loop
  evidence), `2dcb`/`agatoid-relatable-phoebe` (the misclassification fix this was discovered_from,
  landed `8b8fa7c00645`), `f6fc`/`tokophobic-segregated-stinkbug` (the memo+nudge design),
  `2948`+`0707` (banked recovery + tool-free finalizer). No open duplicate.
- 0(b) Floor: `d49466b5` (2026-08-25). `agent_call.py` is UNCHANGED since the floor. Ticket
  created 2026-08-25 15:24. The `served_streak` backstop landed 2026-08-14 (`a0fc8d43`) — 11 days
  BEFORE this ticket.
- 0(c) Worktree current at `82a0d5cd` == origin/main.

### Mechanism (confirmed statically + via git) — 2 of 3 proposed mechanisms already shipped
This ticket proposes three actuators to "steer the model to stop". On current origin/main:
1. ModelRetry/ToolFailed hard steer on the Nth identical call — NOT implemented. The memo
   returns cached content + a graduated STATIC nudge (agent_call.py: `cache[sig] + nudge` :189;
   `_slice_cached_read(...) + nudge` :248; `_MEMO_NUDGE_L1/L2`). This is the sole unimplemented ask.
2. UsageLimits(tool_calls_limit) — already implemented (structured_run.py:485, runner.py:747:
   `tool_calls_limit=max(8, eff_max_iter)`). Predates this ticket.
3. tool_choice=none / tool-free finalization — already implemented as the tool-free LLM finalizer
   (completion_recovery._run_finalizer -> RunRequest.for_structured with no tools) plus a
   deterministic no-LLM fallback so a run with any banked progress "can never die verdict-less"
   (2948/0707/c827). Predates this ticket.

The ticket's premise that "cache-hit repeats are not counted toward the runaway window" is answered
by the served-streak backstop (runaway_guard.py): it counts calls answered WITHOUT executing
a tool (memo hits + notices) and aborts a pure cache-served loop at `REPETITION_WINDOW = 24` —
exactly the incident's 24x. So a cache-served loop is already bounded into re-runnable recovery, not
left to burn the budget.

Taxonomy: the behavior targeted is #6 Termination-awareness failure (model re-runs the same
read_file). The remaining proposal reframes the actuator (passive nudge -> hard ModelRetry) — a
DYNAMIC claim (model loops despite the nudge) that would need a live multi-sample Bedrock eval per
test-design section 10 to confirm.

### Legitimacy: intended-behavior (passive nudge is deliberate) + feature-request/hardening (ModelRetry steer)
The current passive/static nudge is a deliberate, cited design, not a defect:
- f6fc (LANDED): "graduated nudge-then-abort is the recommended pattern"; "static text only —
  a templated nudge keeps message content byte-stable for provider prompt caching." A hard
  ModelRetry would reverse this and break prompt-cache byte-stability.
- a0fc8d43/3211 (LANDED): memo-served repeats were DELIBERATELY made non-loop-evidence to stop
  the guard aborting legitimate re-reads. A hard ModelRetry on repeated read-only calls risks
  RE-INTRODUCING that exact false-positive class.
- The ticket's OWN text: "Separate hardening ... reduces loop frequency / improves convergence but
  not required for that fault's correctness."

Blast radius: agent_call.build_agent_kwargs is the SHARED seam for ALL reviewers (plan-review,
completion-verifier, code-review, spec-scan) through the single runner.py. A nudge->ModelRetry
change affects every LLM gate, not just the completion verifier this ticket names.

### Disposition (handoff to operator)
No cited authoritative source (spec/contract/test/invariant) requires a hard steer; the passive
nudge is deliberate cited design; the correctness harms (lost verdict / forced close / non-
convergence) are already mitigated by landed work (2dcb + served-streak backstop + tool-free
finalizer + deterministic fallback). Implementing proposal #1 is therefore a design decision
(reverses f6fc, cross-gate blast radius, risks 3211's false-positive regression), not a localized
instruction defect — so rebar-debug's fail-closed not-a-bug guard STOPS before Phase 2.

Recommended: either (a) close as largely OBE / intended-behavior (2 of 3 mechanisms shipped;
correctness addressed), or (b) if the hard steer is still wanted, RE-SCOPE bug->task/story with
plan-review so the prompt-cache-stability tradeoff and the affirmative-framing of any new steer are
decided by a human. No caused_by attribution: not a defect.
